body.p: assumptions: identical Km for simvastin & simvastatin acid; identical Km in liver and intestine [Prueksaritanont2003, Prueksaritanont1997] 21-29 [µM]

Functional CYP3A5 of the genotype in the liver and the intestine: 0 for *3/*3 (the reference of the model; *3 is a splicing defect without functional protein), 0.5 for *1/*3 and 1 for *1/*1. Set by the experiments, not fitted.

parameter.name: capacity of CYP3A5 *1/*1 relative to CYP3A4

body.p: Capacity of CYP3A5 in *1/*1 carriers for simvastatin and simvastatin acid relative to the one of CYP3A4. CYP3A5 is at least half of the hepatic CYP3A in *1 carriers (Kuehl2001), its activity per protein for simvastatin is assumed equal to the one of CYP3A4. Not fitted; the CYP3A5 genotypes of Kim2007 (*1/*1 vs *3/*3: AUC of simvastatin 0.30-fold) validate it.

parameter.name: HMG-CoA Reductase inhibitor activity of simmets

body.p: The inhibitor activity of the lumped metabolites relative to simvastatin acid, in the active inhibitors of the enzymatic assays and in the inhibition of the HMG-CoA reductase. The active inhibitors are 0.34 - 0.42 of the total inhibitors (AUC, Pentikainen1992, Prueksaritanont2001); 0.4 gives 0.4 at 40 mg.

body.p: scaling factor for renal function 1.0: normal renal function <1.0: decreased kidney function
Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base, which is 101 ml/min at 75 kg; a measured creatinine clearance of X ml/min is the renal function X/101.

parameter.name: renal clearance of unbound metabolites relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of the simvastatin metabolites is SIMMETSEX_f times the filtration of their unbound fraction, fu_simmets * GFR. The lumped metabolites include polar (inactive) metabolites with a renal clearance far above the filtration of a 95 % bound substance; the value is set so that about 13 % of a dose is excreted in the urine (14C simvastatin, Zocor label), there are no urine data in the studies.

parameter.name: activity of the glucuronidation and CYP2C8 of simvastatin acid

body.p: Activity of the metabolism of simvastatin acid besides CYP3A4 (UGT1A1/1A3 glucuronidation, CYP2C8) relative to the reference. f_ugt < 1: inhibition (e.g. gemfibrozil). Set by the experiments, not fitted.

Activity of OATP1B1 (SLCO1B1) relative to the reference (c.521TT). f_oatp1b1 < 1: reduced activity, the SLCO1B1 c.521T>C variant or an inhibitor of OATP1B1 (e.g. gemfibrozil). Set by the experiments, not fitted.

parameter.name: rate of the metabolism of simvastatin acid not by CYP3A4

body.p: The metabolism of simvastatin acid besides CYP3A4: the glucuronidation (UGT1A1, UGT1A3; followed by the lactonization of the acyl glucuronide) and CYP2C8 (Prueksaritanont2002). The inhibition of these pathways and of OATP1B1 by gemfibrozil increases the AUC of simvastatin acid 2.9-fold (Backman2000) without a change of simvastatin. Without this pathway the acid would rise far more than simvastatin with an inhibitor of CYP3A4, the data show similar ratios (clarithromycin: simvastatin 10-fold, acid 12-fold, Jacobson2004; erythromycin 6.2- and 3.9-fold, Kantola1998).

active HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors in liver

body.p: Fraction of simvastatin in the intestinal lumen which is absorbed into the enterocytes, the rest is excreted in the feces. The absorption of simvastatin relative to an intravenous dose is about 85 % in two animal species (Zocor label; 60 - 85 % Cheng1993, Vickers1990a).
First order rate of the transit of simvastatin from the intestinal lumen (amount based), split into the absorption (F_abs_simva) and the fecal excretion of the unabsorbed fraction.

Fraction of the simvastatin metabolites in the intestinal lumen (from the bile) which is reabsorbed in every round of the enterohepatic circulation; 1 - F_abs_simmets is excreted in the feces. Set with the renal excretion so that about 13 % of a dose is excreted in the urine and the rest in the feces (14C simvastatin: 13 % urine, 60 % feces, Zocor label).
First order rate of the transit of the simvastatin metabolites from the intestinal lumen (amount based), split into the absorption (F_abs_simmets) and the fecal excretion.

Capacity of the intestinal CYP3A4 for simvastatin, independent of the liver. Together with SIMVAEXP_Vmax it sets the intestinal availability (about 0.25 - 0.3, Lilja2004); not identified by the data of the control arms, not fitted.
Assuming the Km of OATP1B1 in the liver for simvastatin lactone 9.7 µM (Chen et al., 2005).
Export of the reabsorbed metabolites into the gut plasma, fast compared to their transit (not rate limiting).
log(2) ~ 0.693 used for conversion of half-life injection time to injection rate.
